in_sanskrit.name: Qaisa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Living in the Moment
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Qaisa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। She who is always present in the moment and embodies the essence of life, like a beautiful flower in full bloom under the moonlight.

in_tamil.name: Qaisa
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Living in the Moment
in_tamil.long_meaning: Qaisa ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। She who is always present in the moment and embodies the essence of life, like a beautiful flower in full bloom under the moonlight.

in_telugu.name: Qaisa
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Living in the Moment
in_telugu.long_meaning: Qaisa ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। She who is always present in the moment and embodies the essence of life, like a beautiful flower in full bloom under the moonlight.

in_marathi.name: Qaisa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Living in the Moment
in_marathi.long_meaning: Qaisa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who is always present in the moment and embodies the essence of life, like a beautiful flower in full bloom under the moonlight.

in_bengali.name: Qaisa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Living in the Moment
